qc.label_under_test: Fires on a stray word-initial 'g' piece (' g', '/g') when the tokenizer splits a word right after its first letter g, mostly Spanish words and slash-joined English words; not on g-words that are whole tokens or split into larger pieces, nor on 'g' for grams.

neighbours.label: Two parts: (1) a Latin-script word-onset fragment of g where the word continues in the next token (' g' in Spanish gobierno/gremial, '/g' in parents/guardians, ' Ng', ' Og', ' antig', ' eng'); (2) Spanish/Portuguese masculine singular articles ' el', ' del', ' un', ' um'. Not whole-token g-words (great, gift, gente), not 'g' for grams, not Arabic or Cyrillic g, not feminine/plural articles (la, una, los) and not English or German articles.
fire: El gobierno anunció nuevas medidas económicas ayer por la tarde.
Please have your parents/guardians sign the permission slip before Friday.

Comprei um carro novo no fim de semana.

predictions: Expect most Spanish/Portuguese masculine-article sentences to fire (~0.3-0.5); g-fragment ones less certain (Dr. Ng, antiguo may be weak). Near misses mostly quiet; 'La gente' / 'La administracion' could leak slightly.
